column3: #2649 closed: LocalStorage.CreateOrUpdateSecretACL now runs its upsert and a FOR SHARE re-read of the live secret node in one transaction and rolls back if the node is gone; DeleteSecret UPDATEs (locks) the secret row before its CWE-284 ACL cascade, so the cascade either sees the committed grant or the grant fails closed. The IsProjectMember read is NOT serial-equivalent against RemoveProjectMember (#4533, open, the second variant #2649 names): a removal committing between it and the upsert leaves an ACL row for a non-member, inert while removed (HasSecretACL re-checks membership, #G13) and live again on re-add; skipped TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_vs_RemoveProjectMember_CrossReplicaPostgres. Proven: TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_vs_DeleteSecret_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_DeleteSecretAfterUpsert_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestLocalACL_RefusesSoftDeletedSecret.
